title: Provider portal home — live state with Combined Member List
description: At Provider Go-Live the dashboard transitions from setup mode to operational mode: the onboarding card is replaced by the active Combined Member List showing all members from both Private and Production environments, with the First Bookable Date surfaced at the top.
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .dashboard-root {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .dash-topnav {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 32px; height: 60px;
    background: rgba(15,14,26,0.95); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
  .dash-topnav__left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
  .dash-topnav__wordmark { opacity: 0.85; }
  .dash-topnav__divider { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
  .dash-topnav__context { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-weight: 500; }
  .dash-topnav__right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .dash-topnav__name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
  .dash-topnav__avatar {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #a78bfa;
  }

  .dash-sidebar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #141222 0%, #110f1f 100%);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px 0; gap: 4px;
  }

  .sidebar-live-chip {
    margin: 0 16px 20px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.2);
    border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  }
  .sidebar-live-chip__top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .sidebar-live-chip__dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4ade80;
    flex-shrink: 0; animation: live-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes live-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0.4); }
    50% { opacity: 0.8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(74,222,128,0); }
  }
  .sidebar-live-chip__label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(74,222,128,0.85); }
  .sidebar-live-chip__date { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); line-height: 1.4; }

  .dash-sidebar__section { padding: 0 16px 16px; }
  .dash-sidebar__section-label {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding: 0 8px 8px; display: block;
  }

  .dash-nav-item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s;
    border: none; background: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-family: inherit;
  }
  .dash-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12); color: #c4b5fd; font-weight: 600; }
  .dash-nav-item__icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.7; }
  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] .dash-nav-item__icon { opacity: 1; }
  .dash-nav-item__count {
    margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  .dash-main {
    overflow-y: auto; padding: 40px 48px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; background: #0f0e1a;
  }

  /* Page header */
  .dash-page-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .dash-page-header__eyebrow { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
  .dash-page-header__title { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff; }
  .dash-page-header__sub { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); line-height: 1.5; max-width: 540px; }

  /* Live status banner */
  .live-banner {
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.2);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 24px;
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 18px;
  }
  .live-banner__icon {
    width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.12);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .live-banner__body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .live-banner__label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(74,222,128,0.7); }
  .live-banner__title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
  .live-banner__desc { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 2px; max-width: 620px; }
  .live-banner__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin-top: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .live-banner__meta-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }
  .live-banner__meta-item strong { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-weight: 600; }
  .live-banner__chips { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .live-banner__chip {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15); color: #86efac; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .live-banner__env-chip {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15); color: #c4b5fd; white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Stats row */
  .stats-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
  .stat-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  }
  .stat-card__label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .stat-card__value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff; line-height: 1; }
  .stat-card__meta { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 2px; }
  .stat-card__env-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .stat-card__env-tag {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px;
  }
  .stat-card__env-tag[data-env="production"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12); color: #c4b5fd; }
  .stat-card__env-tag[data-env="private"] { background: rgba(251,191,36,0.1); color: rgba(253,230,138,0.8); }

  /* Member list section */
  .member-list-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }

  .member-list-header {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .member-list-header__left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .member-list-header__title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .member-list-header__live-dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4ade80;
    animation: live-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .member-list-header__sub { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
  .member-list-header__right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

  .member-list-search {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 14px; height: 38px; width: 220px;
  }
  .member-list-search__icon { opacity: 0.3; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .member-list-search__placeholder { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }

  .member-list-filter-btn {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 14px; height: 38px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
    border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); font-family: inherit; transition: all 0.15s;
  }
  .member-list-filter-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

  /* Table */
  .member-table {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden;
  }

  .member-table-head {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 2fr 100px 140px 140px 120px 100px;
    gap: 12px; padding: 10px 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }
  .member-table-head span {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .member-table-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 2fr 100px 140px 140px 120px 100px;
    gap: 12px; padding: 14px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    align-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s;
  }
  .member-table-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .member-table-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); }

  .member-table-row__person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .member-table-row__avatar {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    flex-shrink: 0; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .member-table-row__name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); }
  .member-table-row__id { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); margin-top: 1px; }

  .member-env-tag {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px;
    width: fit-content;
  }
  .member-env-tag[data-env="production"] { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12); color: #c4b5fd; }
  .member-env-tag[data-env="private"] { background: rgba(251,191,36,0.1); color: rgba(253,230,138,0.8); }

  .member-next-session {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
  }
  .member-next-session__date { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
  .member-next-session__time { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }

  .member-last-session { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }

  .member-digest-btn {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 5px 11px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18);
    color: #c4b5fd; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; transition: background 0.15s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .member-digest-btn:hover { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.18); }

  .member-join-btn {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 5px 11px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.2);
    color: #86efac; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; transition: background 0.15s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .member-join-btn:hover { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.2); }

  .member-action-cell { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; }

  /* First Bookable Date callout */
  .first-bookable-banner {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18);
    border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .first-bookable-banner__icon {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .first-bookable-banner__text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .first-bookable-banner__label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(167,139,250,0.65); }
  .first-bookable-banner__value { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }
  .first-bookable-banner__desc { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 1px; }
  .first-bookable-banner__env {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
  }

  /* Availability summary strip */
  .avail-strip {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 28px;
  }
  .avail-strip__item {
    flex: 1; padding: 12px 16px;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px;
  }
  .avail-strip__item:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .avail-strip__label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
  .avail-strip__value { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
  .avail-strip__sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
  .avail-strip__edit {
    padding: 0 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .avail-strip__edit-btn {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
    transition: all 0.15s; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  .avail-strip__edit-btn:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }

  /* Empty upcoming session row */
  .no-upcoming {
    padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); font-style: italic;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
</style>
